title: Weekend Pancakes for Two
description: A cozy recipe that became our favorite weekend ritual.
body:
We discovered this pancake recipe on a rainy workation morning. It became our quick comfort food whenever the city felt too busy.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups flour
  • 1 1/2 cups milk
  • 2 eggs
  • 1 tsp baking powder
  • 1 tsp vanilla
  • Pinch of salt

Instructions

  1. Whisk the wet and dry ingredients separately.
  2. Combine gently until smooth.
  3. Cook on medium heat until golden brown.
  4. Serve with honey, fruit, or anything that feels like a treat.
